# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_config_docs.py from DEFAULT_CONFIG in config.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

NoType keeps its settings in `settings.json` in the user-data folder: `%APPDATA%\NoType\` on Windows, `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/NoType/` (or `~/.config/NoType/`) elsewhere. Both the Electron app and the Python backend read and write this file; the settings window is the normal way to change it. Keys missing from the file fall back to the defaults below.

Regenerate this page after changing `DEFAULT_CONFIG`:

```bash
python tools/gen_config_docs.py           # rewrite this file
python tools/gen_config_docs.py --check   # exit 1 if it is out of date
```

## Keys in `DEFAULT_CONFIG`

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `language` | `"de"` | any Whisper language code – the UI offers all 99 |
| `app_language` | `"de"` | UI language: de \| en |
| `model_size` | `"small"` | Speech model id from the catalog in transcriber.py / electron/model-catalog.js (tiny, base, small, medium, large-v2, large-v3, large-v3-turbo, distil-large-v3, distil-large-v3.5, german-turbo) |
| `hotkey` | `"ctrl+shift+space"` | Dictation hotkey |
| `mode` | `"hold_to_speak"` | "hold_to_speak" or "press_to_speak" |
| `autostart` | `false` | Start with Windows. The Electron app treats the Windows login item as the source of truth |
| `update_check` | `true` | ask GitHub for a newer release (Electron side) |
| `auto_language_detect` | `true` | also recognize languages outside `languages` |
| `spoken_punctuation` | `true` | "Fragezeichen", "neue Zeile" … become characters |
| `overlay_enabled` | `true` | Currently has no effect: nothing reads it |
| `overlay_style` | `"amoled"` | amoled \| matrix \| island \| halo \| buddy \| slime \| dragon \| mimic \| line (retired ids are migrated by the Electron app) |
| `overlay_position` | `"bottom"` | bottom \| top \| center – applies to every style |
| `overlay_accent` | `"mint"` | mint \| mono \| aurora \| blue \| violet \| red \| amber |
| `overlay_sounds` | `true` | start/stop chimes |
| `initial_prompt` | `""` | custom-vocab bias for Whisper |
| `dictionary` | `[]` | learned corrections [{"from": heard, "to": meant}] |
| `learn_corrections` | `true` | offer fixes typed right after a dictation |
| `save_history` | `true` | keep the last 10 dictations in history.json (Electron side) |
| `command_enabled` | `true` | command mode: rewrite the selection by voice |
| `command_hotkey` | `"ctrl+alt+space"` | Command mode hotkey |
| `agent_enabled` | `false` | agent hotkey: POST the dictation to agent_url instead of typing it |
| `agent_hotkey` | `"ctrl+shift+alt+space"` | Agent hotkey (only registered while `agent_enabled` is on) |
| `agent_url` | `""` | http(s) URL the agent hotkey POSTs to; empty = not set up |
| `agent_token` | `""` | sent as "Authorization: Bearer …" when set |
| `agent_send_context` | `true` | include app name + window title in the request |
| `cleanup_mode` | `"fast"` | off \| fast (rules) \| ai (local LLM via Ollama) |
| `llm_model` | `"qwen3:4b-instruct"` | Ollama model for cleanup_mode="ai" |
| `llm_min_words` | `8` | below this, "ai" mode uses rules only (latency) |
| `insert_method` | `"auto"` | auto (Ctrl+V, fallback typing) \| type |
| `mic_device_name` | `null` | input device by name, None = system default (replaces mic_device_index) |
| `mute_while_dictating` | `false` | mute the speakers while recording |
| `ai_context` | `true` | copies around a dictation into an AI app/terminal go along |
| `live_preview_enabled` | `true` | rolling transcript in the overlay while recording |
| `success_toast` | `false` | popup after successful dictation (errors always show) |
| `gpu_safe_mode` | `false` | disable HW acceleration (flaky-driver escape hatch) |
| `first_run_complete` | `false` | False opens the setup guide on start |

## Other keys

These are read or written by the app but have no default in `DEFAULT_CONFIG`. This list is kept by hand in `tools/gen_config_docs.py`.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `languages` | unset | The languages the user speaks with optional shares, `[{"code": "de", "share": 80}, ...]`. Without it, `language` counts at 100 % |
| `overlay_theme` | unset (= `system`) | Design: `dark`, `light` (Sage) or `system` (follow Windows). Electron only |
| `compute_type` | `auto` (backend) | faster-whisper compute type (CUDA: int8_float16, float16, int8; CPU: int8, float32). The backend persists a working fallback here after a cuBLAS refusal |
| `beam_size` | `auto` (backend) | Beam size for the final pass, `auto` or a number |
| `vad_sensitivity` | `300` (backend) | Minimum silence in ms the VAD needs to split speech |
| `mic_device_index` | unset | Legacy (up to 2.9): PortAudio index, migrated to `mic_device_name` on start |

`electron/main.js` (`loadConfig`) has its own fallback defaults for when it reads the file; the setup guide writes the user's choices on first run.
